package.name: gesture_intent
package.description:
THE CANONICAL GESTURE-INTENT CONTRACT — the second seam into the IT2-FLS, sibling of `tracking`. `GestureIntent` (intent.py) is a frozen stdlib dataclass carrying the recognised command, the operator's identity and bearing, the armed state, and TWO confidences (gesture_confidence, operator_confidence) which the interval type-2 fuzzifier consumes as footprint-of-uncertainty inputs.
The rule this type exists to enforce: a gesture producer emits intent and NEVER velocity. The IT2-FLS is the sole publisher to /cmd_vel, because the whole research contribution is that the same gesture means different things in different social contexts.
DELIBERATELY DEPENDENCY-FREE: pure Python stdlib. No rclpy, no numpy, no mediapipe, no gesture_lab. That is what lets one type survive Foxy (robot) / Humble (dev) / Jazzy (lab) unchanged, and what lets it be shared verbatim with the upstream gesture repo. Do not add dependencies to this package.
